title: Line Graphs of Non-Word-Representable Graphs
exact_target: Does taking a line graph always preserve failure of word representation, or is there a graph that fails to be representable while its line graph is representable?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1436 (GRAPH-049). CC BY 4.0.
Khyodeno Mozhui, Tithi Dwary and K. V. Krishna, Line Graphs of Non-Word-Representable Graphs Are Not Always Non-Word-Representable, arXiv:2509.03339v1 (2025), Sections 1 and 3, Theorem 3.1.
